**Finalizing Estimations**

technical_and_design_decisions: Upgrade Spring Boot dependency in the main build configuration (Gradle/Maven) to align with required RELEASE/SNAPSHOT versions.
Add spring-boot-starter-security to the spring-xd-dirt module and expose server.basic.enabled property defaulting to false in application.yml.
Support single-user security credential overrides via servers.yml configuration file.
Extend Spring XD Shell commands (admin config) to accept --username and --password parameters and configure RestTemplate/HTTP client with Basic Authentication headers.
Create two distinct Dockerfiles (sandbox and production-ready) based on Ubuntu with Java 7 installed; sandbox image will include local Redis and RabbitMQ services managed via an entrypoint script.
assumptions: Development and test environment already supports Java 7 and standard Docker tooling.
Spring XD project uses standard Spring Boot auto-configuration mechanisms for security.
The spike for custom module REST API (U6) is strictly analytical and documentation-focused, producing design docs and user stories without production code implementation.
Automated unit and integration testing hours are included within each respective activity's effort estimate.

activities.activity_description: Update project build files to pull the latest Spring Boot snapshot and RELEASE dependencies (U4, U5), resolve dependency conflicts, and verify overall project build stability.

activities.activity_name: Basic Auth & Single-User Security in spring-xd-dirt
activities.activity_description: Integrate spring-boot-starter-security into spring-xd-dirt (U1), add default configuration server.basic.enabled=false in application.yml, and implement single-user configuration overrides via servers.yml (U2).
Update the XD Shell 'admin config' command to accept --username and --password options (U3) and pass HTTP Basic Auth credentials to the secured XD Admin Server REST endpoints.

activities.activity_name: Spike: Custom Module Archive REST API
activities.activity_description: Assess requirements for custom module archive upload REST API (U6), research architectural options, document findings, review with the team, and create follow-up implementation user stories.
Develop and test a production baseline Docker image containing Ubuntu OS, Java 7, and the full Spring XD Jar distribution (U8).
Develop and test a sandbox Docker image containing Ubuntu OS, Java 7, full Spring XD Jar, Redis, and RabbitMQ along with container startup orchestration (U7).
